actions.label: Erase and set a new password

lede:
This is not a password recovery. The key to your data comes from the password you forgot, so nothing stored under it can be read again — by you, by us, by anyone.

Confirming erases what Carrel keeps for vera: saved connections and their passwords, subscriptions, tags and the settings of this desk. Address books, calendars, tasks and notes on the servers are not touched — you connect to them again afterwards.

The account itself stays: same login, same confirmed address. Only the password is new, and you set it on the next screen.
title: Erase everything and start again?
